title: Automated Daily Sales Reporting Workflow
summary: Scheduled workflow that pulls data from Google Sheets, aggregates it and emails a daily report, replacing manual compilation and distribution.
problem: Compiling and sending a sales report by hand every day takes time and is easy to forget.
objective: Deliver the daily sales report automatically.
approach: A daily schedule trigger reads the sheet, aggregates the figures and sends the report by Gmail.
process: Pulled live data from Google Sheets
impact: Replaces manual report compilation and distribution.
